reason: I have refused third-party cloud tools for years because client confidentiality is non-negotiable, and I will not pay for any platform until I independently verify that Google Drive access is strictly locked down. Furthermore, my article clerks rotate every 2 to 3 years, so if onboarding them is cumbersome while I am reviewing ROC filing annexures at 10 PM, it will just be an expensive distraction.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time, and connecting our Google Drive makes me terrified that confidential client ITR and PAN documents might leak.
would_change_my_mind: Proof during the free pilot that new article clerks can execute ROC filing checklists from Day 1 with zero training, combined with verified zero-access isolation outside the dedicated Drive folder and an airtight trainee download block.
